hooks.command:
cmd=$(python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get("tool_input",{}).get("command",""))' 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; printf '%s
' "$cmd" | grep -Eq '(^|[;&|( ])(git push|gh pr create)( |$)' || exit 0; cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" || exit 0; out=$(scripts/check-doc-links.sh 2>&1); rc=$?; if [ "$rc" -eq 1 ]; then printf 'Blocked before push: scripts/check-doc-links.sh fails, and the guardrails job in pr-tests.yml will fail the same way (doc/agents/Gates.md, Doc links row). Fix the links, commit, then push:
%s
' "$out" >&2; exit 2; fi; out=$(./gradlew -q spotlessCheck 2>&1); if printf '%s' "$out" | grep -q 'format violations'; then printf 'Blocked before push: ./gradlew spotlessCheck reports format violations, and the Tests (JDK 21) job in pr-tests.yml will fail the same way (doc/agents/Gates.md, Formatting row). Run ./gradlew spotlessApply, commit, then push:
%s
' "$(printf '%s' "$out" | tail -n 20)" >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0
